title: No winners of major lotto games as Ultra Lotto jackpot hits P468.9 million
summary: There were no winners of either of the major lotto games played by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office on Sunday, November 1, 2026, with one jackpot now nearly P470 million.

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the major lotto games played by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office on Sunday, November 1, 2026, with one jackpot now nearly P470 million.

No bettor chose the winning combination of 14-34-54-18-05-46 for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game, whose jackpot has risen to a whopping P468,922,422.10. The Ultra Lotto prize has not been won since 10 bettors split the P76.3-million pot in May.
There was also no winner of the Superlotto 6/49 game, with PCSO drawing the winning combination of 44-16-40-19-27-32 for the prize which has risen to P78,612,615.50.
